SHARIAH COMPLIANT DERIVATIVES

Services / Shariah Compliant Derivatives
Enhance Yield. Manage Risk. Optimize Cash. Fatwa Approved.
Shariah Compliant Derivatives

A Shariah compliant derivative solution engineered by Arqaam Capital, is a financial instrument that adheres to Islamic laws through a Musawamah and a Wa’d (A Sales and Purchase agreement with a Unilateral Undertaking). This product allows investors to express a view on underlying assets with or without owning it. Clients utilize these instruments to add to the dividend yield on long term holdings, or gain the required exposure by deploying lesser cash, and in addition hedging against adverse market movements.

For more information, contact derivatives@arqaamcapital.com

Arqaam Capital Limited is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority DFSA. Terms and Conditions apply.
